purpose: Compare application-crate Rust O1 against O3 without changing assertions, overflow checks, panic strategy, native code, model or prompt. Recipe backup only, not execution authority.

environment.CARGO_HOME: <new dedicated Cargo home containing verified regular-file registry cache only>

build_strategy: One no-run --lib --test model_engine compilation must emit actual helper, libtest and model_engine executable records. All three must be freshly compiled (fresh:false) with exact O3 profiles; the separate non-test library artifact is not libtest evidence.
unchanged: Dev/test profile, including debug assertions and overflow checks; no --release, LTO override, panic override or target-cpu/native tuning.
Registry bindings and sys dependency versions/checksums; native CMake Release -O3 with AVX2/FMA/F16C/BMI2/SSE4.2. Verify actual emitted flags and compare retained native build metadata.
Original prompt, grammar, caps, input documents, model hash, three threads and runtime limits; no timer, pool, prompt or topology patches.
artifact_admission: Require actual compiler-artifact.executable paths for both targets and exact profile maps above. Store entire JSON stream plus source/tree/toolchain/config/env hashes.

Verify harness CARGO_BIN_EXE helper uses the exact final binary from this build. Hash final executable bytes/stat identity only after the final build; separate canonical harness copy must preserve hash.
Treat executable hashes as new. Same summary fingerprint covers prompt/grammar/caps only; observe actual header and do not reuse prior native approval as this build proof.
cache_safety: No copying is authorized by this recipe. Before a separate build grant, inventory a proposed source cache.

For an approved cache copy, allow only independent regular files from checksum-qualified registry archive/index/source material. Reject symlinks, sockets/devices, hardlinked mutable files, lockfiles and credentials/config. Use new inodes; never cp -al or hardlink outputs.

Exclude every incremental tree, its relocated symlink targets, target/debug/build CMake trees, build-script output metadata with old absolute paths, and all mutable compiler outputs. Keep a fresh target directory.

Do not clone a current qualified target to simulate a cheap build. Cold offline compilation may exceed the finite budget; report it and seek a newly bounded owner slot without extending or auto-retrying.
bounded_owner_path: Owner serializes a single build slot capped at 1800 seconds including cleanup, fresh memory/disk admission and earlier owner expiry. This is a maximum, not a fit prediction. Cache and native runtime qualification require separate admitted stages.

After no-run build, use the existing native qualification framework for exact helper/harness READY, confinement, descriptor, thread, owned pidfd and kernel EXEC hash checks. No model data need be loaded in the build slot.
Only after native qualification and a fresh runtime grant, run the full original H10 in a separate owner-admitted slot, with unchanged strict grading and 180-second target. No automatic next stage.
risks: App vocabulary scan share is not measured; native decode already O3. No speedup is claimed.
Changing Rust optimization can change code layout, inlining and behavior exposed by undefined behavior. Preserve tie behavior and compare token hashes/output through independent quality grading.
A release build would additionally change panic/LTO/assertions; it is deliberately outside this minimal experiment.
